decision_history: Start from one cube; scale the selected mesh, inset its observed upward face, inspect selection, then extrude inward. No stacked wall primitives or authored answer mesh.
Inspect Workbench cavity render. Floor, walls and rim are present on one 16-vertex, 14-quad cage.
Add a live three-segment angle-limited bevel: narrow edge highlights without changing the planar box envelope. No unnecessary subdivision on the box.
Transfer inset/extrusion to a 16-sided cylinder. Keep two planar cap n-gons explicitly; do not claim an all-quad base cage.
Inspect raw and angle-smoothed radial renders. Smoothing improves wall shading but does not remove the polygonal rim silhouette.
Add level-2 subdivision after the live bevel. Inspect solid and MatCap views; rim becomes rounder but evaluated diameter shrinks from 2.0 to approximately 1.9491.
Re-observe cage IDs and scale only X/Y by 2/1.9491. Re-render and independently inspect the saved asset. Keep the original 64-vertex base topology and live modifiers.
Package independent editable high/low copies in HIGH_POLY and LOW_POLY; low retains live bevel and subdivision at level 0. This is variant packaging, not retopology.

evidence.media_retention: Generated media and Blend checkpoints stay local and ignored. The controlled replay and small measured record are tracked.

limitations: Agent-guided neutral drills, not automated reference-to-construction or held-out successes.
No human or blinded independent visual review; no B4 gate change.
Center ray checks do not prove uniform thickness everywhere or full floor planarity.
Zero BVH overlap candidates and manifoldness do not certify surface quality.
Two planar base cap n-gons are appropriate only while their support and flatness remain controlled; evaluated all-quads do not repair arbitrary bad base topology.
The frozen B0 housing ambiguity is unchanged. This drill does not bypass its selection or reference-authorization gates.
